utterance.raw:
Bob, I get the argument, but your defense still doesn’t solve the main issue: your own route is the only one that overlaps both kill spots at relevant times.

For Charlie, if you really saw him alive in Medbay at tick 13, then the killer had to be in/near Medbay after that — and you were literally there then. None of Alice, Diana, or I have routes that naturally put us in Medbay after that point.

For Eve, you were in Security early with her, then you say you came back through Security later and didn’t see the body. But that also means you had another chance to be there right before Diana found it. Diana self-report is possible, sure, but combined with Charlie, your path fits both deaths way more than anyone else’s.

Alice and Diana at least line up with each other for part of the round, and Diana saw me in Medbay early, which matches my route. I still think Bob is the strongest vote here.
